tool_args.rationale: The boundary probe supplies three supercritical observations in addition to five subcritical pilots, allowing numerical estimation of both avalanche strength and threshold alongside the siphon parameters. Fresh confirmation will test the fitted mechanism against the 0.045 RMSE tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The high-gradient observations drop sharply below the pilot plateau, identifying a supercritical loss term.
The high-gradient probe varies both substrate and gradient, but the supplied mechanism and observed threshold decline favor the gradient-dependent avalanche law.
The three acquired high-gradient rows and five pilot rows identify the specified five-parameter stationary law without another measurement.
